context:
Goal: a lane never stalls on an agent that cannot come back.
Problem (rule): rule roles-resume-by-name says "Resume a dead agent by name, never fresh. A finished reviewer's worktree is gone, so send a fresh reviewer the prior report instead." A resumed builder or test-author whose worktree was cleaned up has the same problem: it stops at the worktree-home guard (lane other-checkout-cp-own, Nov 8). The rule is your text, so widening it needs your word.
Based on (read): main's CLAUDE.md, rule roles-resume-by-name, read 04:19 CST Nov 8.
Based on (read): step resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree (in progress) builds the refusal for the reviewer case.
Departs from: the rule names only a finished reviewer — it would name any finished agent whose worktree is gone, with the same remedy: a fresh agent given the prior report.
Meanwhile: lanes keep working; a stalled builder is restarted by hand.

options.gain: Builders and test-authors stop stalling on a cleaned-up worktree; one rule covers every role.
options.how: The rule reads: "Resume a dead agent by name, never fresh. When a finished agent's worktree is gone, send a fresh agent of the same role the prior report instead." Step resume-finished-reviewer-no-tree widens its refusal to match.
options.label: Cover any finished agent whose worktree is gone
options.lose: A fresh builder starts without the dead one's working memory, only its report.

options.how: The rule stays as written. A resumed builder or test-author with no worktree keeps stopping at worktree-home, and the lane restarts it by hand.
options.label: Keep the rule for reviewers only
options.lose: Lanes keep stalling on reaped builder and test-author worktrees.
